name: comp-464
title: Pagination Page Select
blurb: Pagination with page number input field.
description: Pagination with input field allowing users to directly type and jump to a specific page number.
use_when: Large pagination sets where direct page number entry is faster than clicking.
avoid_when: Small pagination ranges or when you want to guide users through sequential pages.
a11y: Semantic pagination with accessible input field for page number entry.
